title: pvReflect
body:
## pvReflect

Mirrors the input across an axis-aligned plane and outputs an unstructured grid containing, by ParaView default, both the original and the mirrored copy (CopyInput). The plane is either a face of the input bounding box (X Min to Z Max) or x, y or z = Center. Vectors, normals and tensors are flipped; with FlipAllInputArrays (default true) every signed 3-, 6- or 9-component array is treated as a vector or tensor too. Use it to complete a symmetric half-model; the curated reflect uses the same filter with Schemaxis defaults (plane X at 0).

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- ParaView's default plane is X Min, the minimum-x face of the bounding box, not x = 0; choose X with Center 0 for a symmetry plane at the origin.
- The two halves are not merged, so points on the mirror plane are duplicated; run cleanGrid if connectivity across the plane matters.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `Reflect`. Identity: `filters/ReflectionFilter`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the input to the Reflect filter. Accepted data: any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataSet"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Center` | If the value of the Plane property is X, Y, or Z, then the value of this property specifies the center of the reflection plane. | `{"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `CopyInput` | If this property is set to 1, the output will contain the union of the input dataset and its reflection. Otherwise the output will contain only the reflection of the input data. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `FlipAllInputArrays` | If off, only Vectors, Normals and Tensors will be flipped. If on, all 3-component data arrays ( considered as 3D vectors), 6-component data arrays (considered as symmetric tensors), 9-component data arrays (considered as tensors ) of signed type will be flipped. All other arrays won't be flipped and will only be copied. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `Plane` | The value of this property determines which plane to reflect across. If the value is X, Y, or Z, the value of the Center property determines where the plane is placed along the specified axis. The other six options (X Min, X Max, etc.) place the reflection plane at the specified face of the bounding box of the input dataset. | `{"type":"enum","values":["X Min","Y Min","Z Min","X Max","Y Max","Z Max","X","Y","Z"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"X Min"` |

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvReflect",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input"
  }
}
```
